Assuming a 26 cm dinner plate, the meatloaf slab is about 12 × 7 cm and 4 cm thick, roughly 250 g, which gives about 500 kcal including the glaze. The bread roll piece is about 9 × 5 cm, roughly 45 g and 125 kcal. The baby carrots are about 4 pieces at 40 g, roughly 15 kcal. Total is about 335 g and 640 kcal.
